label: Shell
what: The shell is every route's file: it holds the router, the header, the sidebar, and the panes' outer markup, so a commit to it touches all of them and says nothing about which. The Routes tab therefore excludes it from attribution and reports it on its own row. A route whose `files` are empty has no code of its own AT ALL and renders from an inline component in the shell; that is a fact about the app worth reading, not a gap in this file.

label: Overview
what: A repo's front page: its README, with the repo's stats and a jump to the atlas.
note: Renders from overview(), defined inline in the shell, so it has no file of its own. It used to be a three-way choice (a declared landing page, else the pages gallery, else this); the README lost that choice whenever anything else was declared, so the other two became rows of their own.

label: Pages
what: The pages gallery: web-tools' own catalog, or any repo's `pages` entries.
note: A standing view since 2026-08-14, wherever there is a catalog; it used to appear only when a custom landing had taken the front door from it. The same inline gallery() the landing used to use.

label: Atlas
what: The whole-repo treemap, rendered by a separate page the view frames.

label: Config
what: The form over a repo's own .web-tools.json: membership, landing, pins, stage, checks.

label: Project
what: One workspace's front page: overview, board, pages, docs, under a constant header.
note: Assembled inline in the shell from the components the four pills reuse.

label: Repos
what: The card per repo that opts in, grouped, with each repo's scope and adoption read.

label: Stage
what: The bench: the working fileset, its lenses, and the cross-repo transfer.

label: Branches
what: Every live branch across the estate in one list, freshest first, scoped by state: Open, Recent, Stranded, Landed, Abandoned. The cleanup pass over the estate's branches, and the swipe-deck's list. `?view=branches` aliases here, from the retired per-repo review.
note: A pane, then a lens of Sessions from 2026-08-19, a pane again from 2026-08-23, second in the Activity row after Sessions. The demotion read the flat list as a duplicate of what Sessions already nests; what it missed is that the branch scopes are a cleanup pass and a lens inside a session list is the wrong place to run one. The address never moved.

label: Sessions
what: The estate's session records, in four lenses. List nests each session's branches under it as state-tinted tiles; Stars, Repos and Counts draw the session-to-branch relation itself. A session known only from a branch commit trailer appears as a stub, and a branch no key places is listed as unattributed.

label: Chats
what: The conversation archive: the venue with no key joining it to a branch.

label: Routes
what: This pane: the app's own destinations, ranked by when the code behind each last moved.

label: To-do
what: The two personal piles, to-do over jot, in one pane.

label: Jot
what: The same pane as to-do; the key survives so a saved link lands somewhere real.

label: Map
what: The coordination layer made inspectable: the portable set, surfacing, showing, docs, claims, tests, harness, skills, registries.
note: A tab is one registry's detail view, so a registry earns one when its rows read as a filterable list; rows with a rendering of their own (pages, tasks, utility pages) get their view elsewhere in the app

label: Tools
what: The curated gallery of utility pages.

label: Files
what: The central file surface: walk a repo's tree, search names at any ref under any folder, search contents, grep the session records, and read the file in place.
note: The ?view= key stays `search`, its name since the view was a results list: an address is not a label. `?view=files` and a bare `?file=` alias here, from the per-repo tree walk this replaced.

label: State
what: What the estate keeps derived, when each cache was last checked, and what the estate itself did in the last day or week, as a rail of one tick per commit and per session active.
note: Activity's last pill since 2026-08-23. It was a nav stop of its own, which put the estate's motion in two places: this pane answers whether the other pills are current, and that question is asked of them.

label: Proposals
what: Pending cross-repo edits awaiting a confirm; shown in the nav only while something waits.

label: Public browse
what: The tokenless read of any public repo.

label: App view
what: A page some repo promotes, rendered live through toss-render; one address, many destinations.
note: Not a screen this repo draws: the shell frames whatever page the address names. Three spellings, one destination; the short form is what stamp() writes when the open page declares a slug. A deep link into the framed page rides the FRAGMENT, which is the subject's namespace (the shell's is the query), with ?on= as the query fallback for a context that eats the '#'. See lib/kits/url-params.js subject().
